answer: Make reputation decay. Every agent's trust score loses 10% each epoch unless renewed by fresh, peer-graded work, so an idle identity slides from the ridge of high standing into a canyon of near-zero weight within weeks. A sybil farm can't stockpile aged accounts like cargo at a wharf and launch them later: keeping 500 clones voting-ready means paying for 500 graded tasks every epoch, about 2,500 tokens a week, before the attack earns anything.
